create_transforms_pipeline: create a video augmentation pipeline using make_transforms with configurable flip, resize, and normalization options
build_video_transform: build a VideoTransform instance for applying random resized crops, horizontal flips, and pixel erasing to video tensors
test_normalize_tensor: test the _tensor_normalize_inplace function to normalize video tensors with custom mean and standard deviation values
run_auto_augment: run video transforms with auto_augment enabled to apply rand-m7 random augmentation on image buffers
review_motion_shift_crop: review the VideoTransform class and its motion_shift option that uses random_resized_crop_with_shift for spatial cropping
